method: Native filled polygons sampled at0.025mm intervals on fixed x8..22 sections over y13..25. Inclusive endpoints add0.025mm maximum sampling bias. Values sum possibly separated copper intervals; they are not connected bottleneck widths, current paths, resistance bounds or transient PDN qualification. Layer identities are normalized by the explicit8→12 mapping. No CAD edits.
